hypotheses.persona: Single adult with a dog, working a flexible schedule (likely remote or hybrid). The phone leaves home around 07:00 for a morning walk (returns ~07:30-07:45) and again around 17:00 for an afternoon walk (returns ~17:45). This pattern is observed on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and now Thursday (Days 7, 8, 9, 10). On Saturday and Sunday, the same pattern occurs. On earlier weekdays (Day 0, Day 4), the phone left at ~07:00 and returned at ~17:00 without a midday return, which could be days the resident went to the office. The dog's items (chew toy, cushion, blanket) are moved to the pet bed in the morning and afternoon, confirming the dog is active. Meals are eaten at home (breakfast ~08:30, lunch ~12:30, dinner ~18:30) with dishes cleaned promptly. The phone ends up on the nightstand around 22:00-22:30, suggesting a consistent bedtime. No laptop or work bag observed yet, but the resident likely works from home on most days.
hypotheses.rationale: The Thursday data (Day 10) matches the pattern seen on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday: phone leaves ~06:51, returns ~07:36 (morning walk), then leaves ~17:06, returns ~17:51 (afternoon walk). This is now four consecutive weekdays with the same pattern, strongly supporting a flexible/remote work schedule. The earlier weekdays (Day 0, Day 4) are now the minority and likely represent occasional office days. The dog's items (chew toy, blanket) are moved to the pet bed in the morning and afternoon, confirming the dog is active. Meals are at similar times. The probability is increased from 0.15 to 0.85 because the evidence is now overwhelming.
